options.content: NTIEM · CETP · lab, flow and power forms  ·  thin lines: daily values  ·  light blue dashed: calendar-month average (sensor charts: 30-day average)  ·  dashed lines and shaded bands: warning and limit  ·  red dots: samples outside the limit  ·  headline figures: Site Performance · today: Daily Overview

panels.description: Each lab result for the selected period (thin line), each calendar month's average (thick segment, months with at least 3 samples), and samples outside the limit (red dots). Limits shown as dashed lines with shaded bands.

targets.rawSql: SELECT l.time_of_sample_collection AS time, CASE WHEN regexp_replace(btrim(l.location), '\s*:.*$', '') = 'Inlet' AND btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) = 'COD' THEN 'Inlet' END AS metric, l.result::numeric AS value FROM user_labtestdata l JOIN user_customform f ON f.id = l.form_id WHERE f.team_id = 25 AND ((regexp_replace(btrim(l.location), '\s*:.*$', '') = 'Inlet' AND btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) = 'COD')) AND $__timeFilter(l.time_of_sample_collection) AND l.time_of_sample_collection < now() ORDER BY 1

WITH s AS (SELECT l.time_of_sample_collection::timestamptz AS time, l.result::numeric AS v, date_trunc('month', l.time_of_sample_collection::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AS m FROM user_labtestdata l JOIN user_customform f ON f.id = l.form_id WHERE f.team_id = 25 AND ((regexp_replace(btrim(l.location), '\s*:.*$', '') = 'Inlet' AND btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) = 'COD')) AND $__timeFilter(l.time_of_sample_collection) AND l.time_of_sample_collection < now()),
monthly AS (SELECT m, avg(v) AS a, count(*) AS n FROM s GROUP BY m)
SELECT time, "Monthly average" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT s.time, monthly.a AS "Monthly average" FROM s JOIN monthly ON monthly.m = s.m WHERE monthly.n >= 3 UNION ALL SELECT monthly.m AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata', NULL::numeric FROM monthly WHERE monthly.m AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata' > $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) x ORDER BY time

panels.title: Outlet COD (mg/L) · warning 225 · limit 250

panels.description: Daily COD reduction: primary = inlet → PC average, secondary = PC average → CFI average, overall = inlet → outlet. Overall target 80 % (style guide); primary and secondary targets to be confirmed for NTIEM.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (SELECT (l.time_of_sample_collection AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AS day, regexp_replace(btrim(l.location), '\s*:.*$', '') AS loc, avg(l.result) AS v FROM user_labtestdata l JOIN user_customform f ON f.id = l.form_id WHERE f.team_id = 25 AND btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) = 'COD' AND $__timeFilter(l.time_of_sample_collection) GROUP BY 1, 2),
s AS (SELECT day, avg(v) FILTER (WHERE loc = 'Inlet') AS i, avg(v) FILTER (WHERE loc ~ '^PC[1-4]$') AS pc, avg(v) FILTER (WHERE loc ~ '^CFI[1-3]-ClarifierOut$') AS cfi, avg(v) FILTER (WHERE loc = 'Outlet') AS o FROM d GROUP BY day)
SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AS time, 'Primary' AS metric, 100 * (i - pc) / NULLIF(i, 0) AS value FROM s WHERE i > 0 AND pc IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'), 'Secondary', 100 * (pc - cfi) / NULLIF(pc, 0) FROM s WHERE pc > 0 AND cfi IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata'), 'Overall', 100 * (i - o) / NULLIF(i, 0) FROM s WHERE i > 0 AND o IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
